pre_execution_amendments.trigger: pre-execution audit found that root aliases could be double-counted and two exact stochastic-neutrality distances lacked formulas
pre_execution_amendments.effect: freezes registry identity, alias handling, and exact rational distance formulas

primary_claim: Within the frozen finite grammar and bounds, independently enumerate typed structure candidates up to isomorphism, evaluate separately declared viability predicates and presumption preorders, quotient mutual preorder equivalence before reporting each plural MSS frontier, compare separately typed distinction partitions, and verify fixed-carrier internal append and external-gate controls. The run does not select an ontological root or establish Ratchet, basin, QIT, cosmological, or physics claims.

execution_bounds.stop_rule: finish every declared finite candidate, arm, partition, solver query, replay, and corruption control exactly once

engine_mode.name: julia_canon_jax_workhorse_smt_crossover
engine_mode.julia: exact candidate generation, isomorphism canonicalization, automorphism orbits, Graphs.jl SCC viability, exact rational kernel readouts, and result emission
engine_mode.jax: independent candidate generation from this spec, x64 batched permutation tests, partition and frontier recomputation
engine_mode.z3: independent finite encoding of fixed-carrier append-chain subgroup, strictness, and replacement witnesses
engine_mode.cvc5: separate finite encoding of the same bounded witness obligations
engine_mode.pytorch: not_scoped_by_mode: no learning, autograd, or graph-network claim; inclusion would be decorative
engine_mode.lev: execution and zero-execution verification only; no scientific semantics
engine_mode.cross_runtime_rule: Each engine constructs candidates and permutations from spec.json rather than consuming another engine result. Shared spec semantics are expected; shared generated manifests are forbidden before comparison.

candidate_grammar.alias_policy: root and named presentations attach provenance aliases to an existing registry identity rather than adding a second candidate; U_n remains one empty-signature entry, J_n aliases the universal static relation, C_n aliases the universal transition relation, and K0_n aliases the named uniform kernel
candidate_grammar.cross_type_collision_policy: identical adjacency or support data with different semantic_type remains different registry identity until an explicit preorder forgets the type

typed_maps.status: lossy forgetting map; never equates different carrier sizes

presumption_preorders.domain: all registered candidates at fixed n
presumption_preorders.orientation: fewer installed typed primitives is weaker
presumption_preorders.warning: logical axiom strength is not inferred from this structural key

presumption_preorders.domain: candidates with a declared static relation, transition support, or kernel support at fixed n
presumption_preorders.weak_or_equal: A is weaker than or equal to B when support(A) contains support(B)
presumption_preorders.orientation: more permitted ordered pairs is less restrictive
presumption_preorders.quotient_effect: J_n, C_n, and K0_n are mutually equivalent under this deliberately lossy support view

presumption_preorders.domain: all registered candidates at fixed n
presumption_preorders.weak_or_equal: A is weaker than or equal to B when Aut(A) contains Aut(B) as enumerated permutations
presumption_preorders.orientation: more relabeling freedom is structurally less committal
presumption_preorders.warning: U_n, J_n, C_n, K0_n, and other controls can tie; symmetry alone does not imply white noise or variation

presumption_preorders.source_dependence_distance: sum over x=1..n-1 and y=0..n-1 of abs(K(y|x)-K(y|0))
presumption_preorders.destination_bias_distance: sum over y=0..n-1 of abs((1/n)*sum_x K(y|x)-1/n)
presumption_preorders.arithmetic: exact rationals before the final optional display conversion
presumption_preorders.orientation: less source memory and less destination preference is more neutral
presumption_preorders.warning: this is an installed stochastic criterion, not a universal simplicity order

mss_rule.equivalence: A approximately_i B iff A weak_or_equal_i B and B weak_or_equal_i A
mss_rule.strict: A strictly_weaker_i B iff A weak_or_equal_i B and not B weak_or_equal_i A
mss_rule.frontier: the equivalence classes of applicable viable candidates for which no applicable viable candidate is strictly weaker
mss_rule.singleton_result: allowed but scoped to the arm; never an ontological winner
mss_rule.plural_result: retain every incomparable class without a scalar tie-break
mss_rule.cross_arm_policy: report sensitivity; do not rank or MSS-select the constitutions themselves

distinction_relations.definition: states share a class iff some enumerated automorphism maps one to the other
greatest unlabelled strong bisimulation over the declared transition support
equality of the frozen label-blind local fingerprint: self-loop, in-degree, out-degree, sorted successor out-degrees, and sorted predecessor in-degrees
distinction_relations.parameter_policy: no named state parameter and no raw state label

distinction_relations.definition: exact equality of rational transition rows

distinction_comparison.nonconvergence_policy: disagreement is retained as sensitivity and never merged post hoc
distinction_comparison.tautology_policy: agreement forced by a homogeneous candidate such as C_n or K0_n is labelled by_construction, not earned convergence

fixed_carrier_internal_append_chain.required_property: old symbols and interpretations are unchanged, so Aut(A_(k+1)) is a subset of Aut(A_k) as literal permutation sets
fixed_carrier_internal_append_chain.strictness_expectation: A0 to A1 is equality; A1 to A2 and A2 to A3 are strict
fixed_carrier_internal_append_chain.replacement_control: B2 replaces c0=0 with c0=1 instead of appending; Aut(B2) is not a subset of Aut(A2)
fixed_carrier_internal_append_chain.carrier_growth_refusal: no raw subgroup comparison is made between different carrier sizes

external_constraint_controls.required_property: the admitted candidate set shrinks monotonically, while each surviving candidate's internal structure and automorphism set remain byte-identical
external_constraint_controls.forbidden_inference: external filtering is not within-candidate symmetry breaking

claim_ceiling: A bounded classical finite-structure tournament and invariant census for the exact declared grammar and sizes only. Green receipts may establish local execution, exhaustive coverage within the declared relation families, exact fixed-carrier invariants, arm-specific MSS frontiers, solver witness replay, and Julia/JAX agreement. They do not establish an anti-thing, ontological root, derived distinguishability, positive drive, search dynamics, Ratchet tooth, Purgatory process, recurrence, attractor basin, QIT engine, Axis, cosmological conclusion, physics, theorem beyond the bounds, or formal admission.
